acceptance: AC-001: Given a completed-task Change whose managed worktree is dirty, application list/detail and registered get_change report blocked readiness, checks not-run for that preflight, and no executable finalization; their captured basis fields match.

AC-002: Given a clean completed-task Change, show_finalization_context and displayed Finalize agree on candidate/readiness; editing the workspace after the read but before finalize_change causes managed validation to reject without a finalization receipt.

AC-003: Given a failed maintained check or preflight submitted through registered report_finalization_failure with current basis, restart returns its retained category, candidate and checks state while branch, claims, frontier stage and proof receipts remain unchanged.
AC-004: Given the same attempt key and payload twice, submission returns one record; changed payload, stale new basis or mismatched report sequence conflicts without overwriting current evidence.

AC-005: Given a newer candidate/contract, prior reports remain historical and cannot block that candidate; a same-head report alone cannot veto a currently eligible retry or clear an existing lifecycle guard.

AC-006: Given malformed frontier bytes for a known Change, registered MCP output, HTTP list/detail and Cockpit emit the tagged unavailable variant with no mutation action; unrelated entries remain visible and strict parsing still rejects the malformed bytes.

AC-007: Given interruption between report/pointer publication or an injected store write error, restart replays the bounded transaction or shows report-store-unavailable without changing product authority or claiming report success.

AC-008: Given unknown raw-summary, command, URL, log, environment or proof fields, or encoded report size above 16 KiB, validation rejects before persistence; stored fields follow the declared structured report contract.

AC-009: Given a finalizer with trusted context and failed preflight, its registered failure-report handoff retains an identity and says checks did not run; no checkout mutation, claim recovery, or successful finalization occurs.

AC-010: Given ready, blocked, unavailable, running, waiting and complete readiness fixtures, Cockpit renders the engine-selected action/explanation and labels copied prompts as copying, not agent launch.

AC-011: Given successful same-candidate finalization after a failed attempt, the success receipt is current and report history survives pointer retirement; retirement failure cannot replace successful status, and an ordinary read creates or retires no report.

AC-012: Given the P01/P02/P02-W/P03/P04 surfaces in this Design's Packet and Native Planning Scope section, routed core/adapter/HTTP/component checks and registered finalizer handoff pass; known-unavailable remains distinct from unknown Change.
AC-013: Given custody reporting with a changed workspace fingerprint or paths escaping/mismatching engine-observed dirt, reporting rejects without checkout edits or pointer advancement.
AC-014: Given 256 retained reports, the next new attempt returns diagnostic-capacity without deleting history; replay of an existing key returns its original record.

AC-015: Given a per-Change Git inspection timeout, missing workspace, or permission error during list/detail capture, readiness is unavailable with workspace-inspection-failed and no executable finalization; unrelated entries remain usable and mutation rechecks do not assume cleanliness.

AC-016: Given symlinked/non-directory report-root components or an escaped transaction target, report persistence rejects without touching an outside sentinel; authoritative portable snapshot export excludes host-local reports.

AC-017: Given the effective inspect-change prompt configuration, only read-only get_change and delivery_health are available; no terminal, edit, dispatch or Delivery mutation tools are exposed, and fixture outputs explain blockers without raw Git repair instructions.
outcomes.promise: Cockpit and agents receive one snapshot-consistent executable action decision and can inspect failed or unstarted finalization after restart without manual worktree repair or weakened authority.
outcomes.title: Truthful Change readiness and retained finalization failures

The live registered acquire_actions schema showing Change/outcome selection, expected stage/task, frontier and source-head guards.

block.reason: The verified admitted Design and COM-005 require selected-launch release/activation and the effective P01 model route. Fresh Planning context supplies neither evidence nor a resolved request. The worktree Builder declaration names GPT-5.6 Luna, which cannot establish the required Astra override. Planner cannot activate the prerequisite or waive these requirements; no plan was published.

The user explicitly selected 'Submit the existing evidence and continue' after being shown the release, live-tool, named-dispatch observations and limits. This confirms authorization to submit the agent-observed evidence, not that the user independently verified technical contents or waived any gate.

Prerequisite release: ffd71b158d448678b3f890b751298947da9c0e28, recorded 622 passing tests and independent exact-commit Opus maintenance pass, pushed to origin/dev. Direct-tool repair: 4ef59274098ed036c1cdc3f837a9746b1acbb6bc, exact-commit Opus maintenance pass and fresh 30 passing ecosystem tests, pushed and synchronized through receipt 9441387c279f3eb8e10eba0aeddd4df443b44569716824167e48e0bd2f78dd15. Both are ancestors of managed reviewed head 513a72b471e77d411c46fe0139d3dcddff922768; evidence-note sync receipt 94a7d6dd68a26eb8734f8fd64c6170f60e5ac7af5a2f7c8311b8c1d2380bda2d. Exact evidence is in .owlbear/research/delivery-action-readiness-p00.md sections 10-13 at commit 4080b97939d3861a22a92997044ac415a6918c67. Independent assessment corroborated these source commits, ancestry, and current registered schema.

Live selected API: acquire_actions exposes selection change_id, outcome_id, expected_stage planning|implementation, expected_task_id, expected_frontier_digest, expected_source_head; Implementation requires a task. Actual selected calls acquired only this Change. Workspace chat.agentHost.copilot.toolSearch.enabled=false avoids deferral while preserving all agent grants/hooks. A fresh named Builder directly called show_build_context on recovered claim 33a71b47-16b9-483e-a250-e9e4dd0a1f0f and got the expected inactive-identity error; directly callable submit_result schema was confirmed without submission. Absence of discovery is not tool absence when actual bindings exist.

P01 route: actual runSubagent invocations used agentName=builder, model='GPT-6 Astra (copilot)', not the default Luna. The host accepted that registered model selection. The actual claim bf088c78-a48b-4a99-96b7-a6b708c0669b reached fresh Build context and passed direct custody checks, then returned this evidence-handoff issue with no edits. Named Builder previously invoked its permitted build-reviewer with explicit 'Claude Opus 5 (copilot)'; reviewer confirmed callable read-only Git/terminal. The unmodified builder.agent.md grants context/submission and declares SessionStart session-context.py and PostToolUse lint-changed.py; build-reviewer.agent.md declares Opus, restricted read-only tools, and deny-writes.py --terminal-read-only PreToolUse hook. No permissions or hooks were widened or disabled.

Limits and ongoing duties: these are observable named role/tool/nested dispatch facts, not hidden serving-weight attestation. Hook declarations are verified; independent per-dispatch hook/model traces are unavailable. The approved Design already distinguishes model-name acceptance from route verification and hidden identity; this response does not turn declarations into observed hook execution. Reuse existing caller observations in the native task handoff rather than require Builder to prove pre-acquisition facts absent from its context. The acquiring session must continue using exact named Astra Builder / Opus reviewer and actual callable tools with original hooks/custody; no silent default fallback. Planning must assess whether this satisfies the Design, and all exact-commit implementation tests, independent review, and acceptance remain required and unperformed.
block.unblock_condition: A fresh DeliveryPlanContext.requests projection contains a resolved action request supplying verifiable release, live activation, and effective P01 role/tool/model routing evidence consistent with the admitted Design.
